avoid_supplements.name: Methotrexate
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both agents are DMARDs with overlapping hepatotoxicity and myelosuppression risk; synergistic toxicity to bone marrow and liver
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use unless explicitly prescribed and monitored by rheumatologist

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Folic Acid (>5 mg/day without medical supervision)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sulfasalazine inhibits folate absorption; excessive supplementation may mask deficiency or cause imbalance
avoid_supplements.action: Use only prescribed folate doses (typically 1 mg daily); coordinate with prescriber

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements (concurrent dosing)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sulfasalazine reduces iron absorption; concurrent high-dose iron may cause GI irritation and impaired efficacy of both agents
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2-3 hours; monitor for anemia

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Sulfasalazine is activated by gut bacteria; probiotics may alter drug metabolism and efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; separate dosing by 2 hours and monitor therapeutic response

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B12 supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Sulfasalazine impairs B12 absorption; supplementation may help offset deficiency
caution_supplements.action: Monitor B12 levels; consider supplementation if deficiency develops

avoid_foods.name: Excessive high-fiber foods (concurrent with dosing)
avoid_foods.mechanism: High fiber can reduce sulfasalazine absorption and increase GI transit time, reducing bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Consume fiber-rich foods 2+ hours apart from sulfasalazine dose

caution_foods.name: Dairy products
caution_foods.mechanism: Calcium in dairy may slightly reduce sulfasalazine absorption
caution_foods.action: Separate dosing by 2 hours from high-calcium foods

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol increases hepatotoxicity risk and GI irritation with sulfasalazine
caution_foods.action: Minimize alcohol consumption; avoid binge drinking

monitoring_notes: Monitor CBC, liver function, and folate/B12 levels regularly (baseline and every 8-12 weeks). Counsel patients on GI side effects, increased photosensitivity, and the importance of maintaining adequate hydration and taking sulfasalazine with food if GI upset occurs.
